items.prompt: Redraw the pearl-shell lake decoration so it matches reference image 1 (the approved gameplay concept crop) much more closely. Three open scalloped shells, each holding one pearl on a sandy beige inner lip, arranged in a triangle (one top, two below) exactly as in reference 1. Use the muted dusty blue-violet shell colour, darker blue-grey outlines, flat matte colour planes and the small calm pearl highlights of reference 1. Keep the canvas framing and the overall size of the shell group from reference 2 so the in-game scale does not change, but remove its glowing halo: no outer glow, no bloom, no light rays. The shells sit flat as seen from the elevated top-down gameplay camera, with a soft upper-left light and only a faint contact shadow. Isolated object on true transparency, centred with an even margin.
avoid: outer glow, bloom or halo around the shells
water, waves, ground or rocks around the object
glossy 3D, heavy gradients or photoreal shell texture
bright neon pearls
extra shells, starfish or other new ornaments
text, UI, range rings, arrows, balls
checkerboard or coloured backdrop

- Image 1: exact crop of the approved gameplay concept: the shape, colours, outline weight and arrangement to match (three open shells with pearls, triangle layout)
- Image 2: current game resource: keep its canvas framing and the size of the shell group on the canvas so the in-game scale stays the same; do NOT copy its strong blue glow halo or its brighter, puffier rendering
- Image 3: final gameplay look of the lake region: muted palette, flat matte colour planes, soft upper-left light

Redraw the pearl-shell lake decoration so it matches reference image 1 (the approved gameplay concept crop) much more closely. Three open scalloped shells, each holding one pearl on a sandy beige inner lip, arranged in a triangle (one top, two below) exactly as in reference 1. Use the muted dusty blue-violet shell colour, darker blue-grey outlines, flat matte colour planes and the small calm pearl highlights of reference 1. refs.role: EXACT TARGET: the pearl shells as drawn in the approved gameplay concept. Copy these shells: upright scalloped back valve fanning behind, pale grey-lavender shell with soft violet-grey shading, dark slate outline, sandy beige inner lip, one white-blue pearl with a small calm highlight, sitting in the water with a thin ripple ring and a soft dark underwater shadow
the same shells elsewhere in the concept: confirms the shape, the pair arrangement (one larger shell behind, one smaller shell in front and to the side) and the water contact
the whole lake panel of the gameplay concept: palette, outline weight, flat painterly colour planes, soft upper-left light, detail density next to the balls

items.prompt: Redraw the lake pearl-shell decoration exactly as it appears in the approved gameplay concept (reference 1 is the target, reference 2 shows the same shells again). Two open scallop shells as a pair: one larger shell behind and one smaller shell in front and slightly to the side, overlapping a little, exactly like reference 1. Each shell has an upright fan-shaped back valve with broad flat ridges, pale grey-lavender colour with soft violet-grey shading, a dark slate outline, a sandy beige inner lip and one round white-blue pearl with a small calm highlight. Keep the concept's slightly elevated top-down view and soft upper-left light. Include only what belongs to the object in the water: a thin pale ripple ring where each shell meets the water and a soft dark shadow under the shells, both fading out to transparency. No surrounding water colour, rocks, lily pads or ground. Match the flat painterly colour planes and outline weight of reference 3 so it sits naturally next to the balls. Isolated object on true transparency, centred with an even margin, filling about two thirds of the canvas width.
avoid: three shells or a triangle layout (that was the old object sheet design)
outer glow, bloom or halo
opaque water patch, rocks, lily pads or ground behind the shells
glossy 3D, photoreal shell texture or heavy gradients
bright neon pearls
starfish, coral or other new ornaments
text, UI, range rings, arrows, balls
checkerboard or coloured backdrop
accept: 게임플레이 원화 크롭(참조 1·2)의 조개와 같은 형태·색·윤곽으로 보임
큰 조개 뒤·작은 조개 앞의 두 개 배치
물에 닿는 잔물결과 물속 그림자가 투명하게 사라짐

refs.role: EXACT TARGET SCENE from the approved gameplay concept: the two pearl shells in the water with a mossy grey rock beside them, floating four-leaf water plants, a lily pad, a loose pearl and ripples. Copy this composition and how the pieces overlap
the same shells at another spot in the concept: shells against large grey bank rocks, reeds and lily pads; shows how rocks and plants frame the shells
the shell design to keep for the two shells (shape, colour, outline, pearls); only the shells, not its empty surroundings
the whole lake panel: palette, outline weight, flat painterly colour planes, soft upper-left light, how the props sit on the deep blue water

items.prompt: Paint a small lakeside vignette from the approved gameplay concept (reference 1 is the target scene, reference 2 shows the same idea elsewhere) as one reusable decoration. In the middle, the two open pearl shells as a pair, one larger behind and one smaller in front, using the shell design of reference 3. Around them, exactly in the concept's style: one or two mossy grey rocks partly in the water beside the shells, two or three round lily pads, a few small floating four-leaf water plants, a short clump of reeds at one side and one small loose pearl, with thin pale ripple rings and soft dark underwater shadows where things meet the water. The shells stay the clear focal point; the rocks and plants frame them and must not cover them. Do not paint the open lake water itself: the water colour between the props is left transparent, and every outer edge (ripples, shadows, plant tips) fades softly to transparency so the vignette blends into the game's lake floor. Same elevated top-down view, soft upper-left light, flat painterly colour planes and outline weight as reference 4. Isolated on true transparency, centred, filling about three quarters of the canvas width with an even margin.
avoid: an opaque square or circular patch of water behind the vignette
hard cut-out edges around the group
shells hidden behind rocks or leaves
three shells or a triangle layout
outer glow, bloom or halo
glossy 3D, photoreal textures or heavy gradients
bright neon pearls
trees, land ground, sand beach
text, UI, range rings, arrows, balls
checkerboard or coloured backdrop
accept: 게임플레이 원화 크롭(참조 1·2)처럼 조개·이끼 돌·연잎·수초·갈대가 한 장면으로 보임
조개 두 개가 가운데 눈에 띄고 돌·잎에 가려지지 않음
물 색은 칠하지 않고 바깥 가장자리가 투명하게 흐려져 호수 바닥과 어우러짐
